brief.goal: Add n8n as a hidden Docker sidecar to the Electron productivity dashboard, providing workflow automation, polling, and health-check monitoring.
brief.constraints: Electron desktop app (existing project), n8n runs as Docker sidecar hidden from user (REQ-020), health-check endpoint monitored by app (REQ-023), auto-restart on failure, Alpha milestone (PDR-003)
brief.non_goals: Exposing n8n editor UI to users, n8n workflow customization UI in the Electron app, external Docker orchestration (Kubernetes, Swarm), Phase 2+ features (M365 connector, LAN dashboard)
success_criteria: docker-compose.yml with n8n service exists and is valid
n8n editor is NOT exposed (no port mapping to host)
Health-check endpoint is monitored by the Electron main process
Integration with existing Electron app via IPC for status reporting

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the n8n Docker sidecar
Create docker-compose.yml, n8n service config, health-check module, IPC handlers
Verify implementation against spec and acceptance criteria

specify.output: Feature specification written to specs/002-n8n-docker-sidecar/spec.md covering docker-compose.yml, health checks, IPC handlers, and security requirements.

implement.output: Created docker-compose.yml, Docker compose/health modules, n8n IPC handlers, updated main process lifecycle, and preload allowlist.

converge.output: Verified all acceptance criteria: docker-compose.yml valid, n8n not exposed to host, health check configured, auto-restart policy set, IPC integration complete. Lint and typecheck pass.
